name: AOC Provider and Personal Data Adapter Layer
description: Extend the canonical Agent Operating Company runtime and integration layer with governed Grok, Gemini, Copilot, iCloud, and local iPhone adapters supporting bounded read, draft/write, continuous synchronization, provenance, health probes, checkpoints, and normalized receipts.
purpose: Provide a portable, evidence-backed ingestion and action boundary that continuously retrieves authorized documents and data into Canon while preserving provider limits, mobile sandbox constraints, least privilege, human approval gates, and reversible writes.
features: iCloud CloudKit and user-selected Files bridge
Local iPhone app-container and document-picker bridge
Checkpoints, retries, dead-letter records, and receipts
justification: The existing Canon repository already contains the canonical runtime-adapter contract, task/passport controls, registry schemas, and declarative Grok/Gemini profiles. This work should extend those assets with live data adapters and mobile bridge contracts rather than create a new control plane.
